subject: Life Skills
title: Conformity and Asch's Lines
description: One-minute skill: Conformity and Asch's Lines.

hook.text: Solomon Asch showed people two obviously different lines. When actors chose the wrong one.

buildup.text: The subjects knew the answer was wrong but went along to avoid standing out. Group pressure overrode their own eyes.

discovery.text: Conformity spikes when the group is unanimous. Just one dissenter — even a wrong one — collapses the pressure.

twist.text: Conformity is not always bad. Following traffic rules and social norms keeps society functional.

climax.text: Before agreeing with a group, check: would I hold this opinion alone? If not, you are conforming, not deciding.

punchline.text: One dissenting voice frees the rest. Be that voice.

quiz.question: What dramatically reduces group conformity pressure?
options: Having even one person disagree with the group
Increasing the size of the group
